verdict.rationale: Docusaurus has no documented API playground. Its MDX support lets authors embed their own React components, or third-party npm components, directly in docs pages, and its plugin architecture is extensible, so an interactive try-it console could be added only through custom or external tooling. Missing for 10: a native or first-party API playground, OpenAPI-driven reference generation, documented try-it-out request execution, and any hands-on corroboration of a playground working in Docusaurus.
